parsed.explanation: A strong rule-of-law democracy with a national, visitor-relevant trans-protection framework: self-declared legal recognition, hate-crime penalties covering gender identity, anti-discrimination machinery, and — critically — documented custody practice where trans people choose their own placement and trans women are held in female prisons. No traveler-facing restriction is documented: no facility ban, no presentation offence, no border friction, no police targeting. The one documented killing (2025) was prosecuted with a 7-year sentence — a single incident with judicial follow-through, i.e., background-level violence with functioning recourse, not a campaign. The resident-outcome statistics (two-thirds violence, life expectancy, education/employment exclusion) describe the local sphere — prostitution, family rejection, schooling — which a visitor does not enter, and they are outweighed by documented acceptance (top of regional rankings, large pride events, failed repeal referendum). Open questions (no third marker, uneven enforcement, pending hospital complaint, unopened prison sector) are edge cases, not exposures, holding the score below 0.90.
